import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

root = Path.cwd()
render = importlib.import_module('render-audit')
contrast = importlib.import_module('contrast-audit')
report = []
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(channel='chrome', headless=True)
    for width in [1440, 390]:
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width':width,'height':1000})
        page.route('**/googletagmanager.com/**', lambda route: route.abort())
        errors=[]
        page.on('pageerror',lambda error:errors.append(str(error)))
        url='http://127.0.0.1:4183/datafolha_22102026.html'
        issues=render.audit(page,url)
        assert not issues, issues
        assert page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth'), 'page overflow'
        page.screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/desktop-{width}.png'))
        assert '50 × 50' in page.locator('#round-result').inner_text()
        page.locator('#round-f').fill('47.49')
        page.locator('#round-l').fill('45.50')
        assert '51 × 49' in page.locator('#round-result').inner_text()
        page.locator('#round-f').fill('46.80')
        page.locator('#round-l').fill('46.49')
        page.locator('.rounding-lab').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/rounding-{width}.png'))
        page.locator('#cotas').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/quotas-{width}.png'))
        options=page.locator('#d-question option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for option in options:
            page.locator('#d-question').select_option(option)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
            href=page.locator('#d-explorer-chart a[href*="#page="]').first.get_attribute('href')
            assert 'datafolha_22102026.pdf#page=' in href,href
        page.locator('#d-question').select_option('voto')
        dimensions=page.locator('#d-dimension option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for value in dimensions:
            page.locator('#d-dimension').select_option(value)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
        page.locator('#explorador').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/explorer-{width}.png'))
        problems=contrast.audit_page(page,url)
        report.append({'width':width,'render':issues,'contrast':problems,'questions':len(options),'dimensions':len(dimensions),'js_errors':errors})
        assert not errors,errors
        page.close()
    page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1440,'height':1000})
    old=render.audit(page,'http://127.0.0.1:4183/datafolha_08102026.html')
    report.append({'old_dossier_render':old})
    browser.close()
(root/'tmp/datafolha_221026/qa.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))

name: Publish GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Fetch public documents from Git LFS
        run: git lfs pull --include="docs/**"
      - name: Verify documents contain PDF bytes, not LFS pointers
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          documents = list(Path('docs').rglob('*.pdf'))
          for path in documents:
              with path.open('rb') as handle:
                  assert handle.read(5) == b'%PDF-', f'Invalid public PDF: {path}'
          print(f'{len(documents)} public PDF files verified')
          PY
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: docs
      - name: Deploy site
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "master"]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint (ruff + black)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Install lint tools
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install 'ruff~=0.16.5' 'black~=26.3.1'
      - name: ruff check
        run: ruff check scripts/ docs/
      - name: black --check
        run: black --check scripts/ docs/

  test:
    name: Test (py${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Sitemap lastmod values require each page's actual commit date.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Fetch public PDF evidence for audit tests
        run: git lfs pull --include="docs/fontes/**,data/originals/*_092026_24/**,data/originals/*_092026_29/**,data/originals/*_092026_30/**,data/originals/*_102026_*/**,data/originals/mda_092026_15/**,data/pesquisas/quaest/2026-07/Quaest_072026.pdf,data/pesquisas/quaest/2026-09-23/**,data/originals/pesquisas_2022/**,data/originals/senado_102026/**"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -e ".[audit,dev]"
      - name: Run test suite
        run: python -m pytest -q

  build-docs:
    name: Build interactive HTML essay
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, test]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -e .
      - name: Validate docs/index.template.html renders against fixtures
        run: |
          # Template sanity: ensures Python can substitute the known placeholders.
          # JS template literals like ${cls} are expected to remain and are ignored.
          python - <<'PY'
          import re
          from string import Template
          from pathlib import Path
          tpl = Template(Path('docs/index.template.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          html = tpl.safe_substitute(
              PAYLOAD='{"trimestral":{"modes":{"alvo":{}}},"anual":{"modes":{"alvo":{}}},"geojson":{"features":[]}}',
              BUILT_AT='ci',
              VINTAGE_TRI='ci',
              VINTAGE_ANN='ci',
          )
          assert '<title>' in html, 'template missing title'
          # Only check that our build placeholders (all UPPER_SNAKE) resolved.
          build_placeholders = re.findall(r'\$\{([A-Z_]+)\}', html)
          assert not build_placeholders, f'unresolved build placeholders: {build_placeholders}'
          print('template OK')
          PY
      - name: Upload docs artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: docs-html
          path: |
            docs/index.html
            docs/index.template.html
            docs/build_index.py
            docs/artigo_pt.md
            docs/artigo_en.md

        page.locator('#d-question').select_option('voto')
        dimensions=page.locator('#d-dimension option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for value in dimensions:
            page.locator('#d-dimension').select_option(value)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
        page.locator('#explorador').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/explorer-{width}.png'))

        page.close()

    browser.close()

import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

root = Path.cwd()
render = importlib.import_module('render-audit')
contrast = importlib.import_module('contrast-audit')
report = []
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(channel='chrome', headless=True)
    for width in [1440, 390]:
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width':width,'height':1000})
        page.route('**/googletagmanager.com/**', lambda route: route.abort())
        errors=[]
        page.on('pageerror',lambda error:errors.append(str(error)))
        url='http://127.0.0.1:4183/datafolha_22102026.html'
        issues=render.audit(page,url)
        assert not issues, issues
        assert page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth'), 'page overflow'
        page.screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/desktop-{width}.png'))
        assert '50 × 50' in page.locator('#round-result').inner_text()
        page.locator('#round-f').fill('47.49')
        page.locator('#round-l').fill('45.50')
        assert '51 × 49' in page.locator('#round-result').inner_text()
        page.locator('#round-f').fill('46.80')
        page.locator('#round-l').fill('46.49')
        page.locator('.rounding-lab').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/rounding-{width}.png'))
        page.locator('#cotas').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/quotas-{width}.png'))
        options=page.locator('#d-question option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for option in options:
            page.locator('#d-question').select_option(option)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
            href=page.locator('#d-explorer-chart a[href*="#page="]').first.get_attribute('href')
            assert 'datafolha_22102026.pdf#page=' in href,href
        page.locator('#d-question').select_option('voto')
        dimensions=page.locator('#d-dimension option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for value in dimensions:
            page.locator('#d-dimension').select_option(value)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
        page.locator('#explorador').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/explorer-{width}.png'))
        problems=contrast.audit_page(page,url)
        report.append({'width':width,'render':issues,'contrast':problems,'questions':len(options),'dimensions':len(dimensions),'js_errors':errors})
        assert not errors,errors
        page.close()
    page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1440,'height':1000})
    old=render.audit(page,'http://127.0.0.1:4183/datafolha_08102026.html')
    report.append({'old_dossier_render':old})
    browser.close()
(root/'tmp/datafolha_221026/qa.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))

cat > tmp/datafolha_221026/qa.py <<'PY'
import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

root = Path.cwd()
render = importlib.import_module('render-audit')
contrast = importlib.import_module('contrast-audit')
report = []
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(channel='chrome', headless=True)
    for width in [1440, 390]:
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width':width,'height':1000})
        page.route('**/googletagmanager.com/**', lambda route: route.abort())
        errors=[]
        page.on('pageerror',lambda error:errors.append(str(error)))
        url='http://127.0.0.1:4183/datafolha_22102026.html'
        issues=render.audit(page,url)
        assert not issues, issues
        assert page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth'), 'page overflow'
        page.screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/desktop-{width}.png'))
        assert '50 × 50' in page.locator('#round-result').inner_text()
        page.locator('#round-f').fill('47.49')
        page.locator('#round-l').fill('45.50')
        assert '51 × 49' in page.locator('#round-result').inner_text()
        page.locator('#round-f').fill('46.80')
        page.locator('#round-l').fill('46.49')
        page.locator('.rounding-lab').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/rounding-{width}.png'))
        page.locator('#cotas').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/quotas-{width}.png'))
        options=page.locator('#d-question option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for option in options:
            page.locator('#d-question').select_option(option)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
            href=page.locator('#d-explorer-chart a[href*="#page="]').first.get_attribute('href')
            assert 'datafolha_22102026.pdf#page=' in href,href
        page.locator('#d-question').select_option('voto')
        dimensions=page.locator('#d-dimension option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for value in dimensions:
            page.locator('#d-dimension').select_option(value)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
        page.locator('#explorador').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/explorer-{width}.png'))
        problems=contrast.audit_page(page,url)
        report.append({'width':width,'render':issues,'contrast':problems,'questions':len(options),'dimensions':len(dimensions),'js_errors':errors})
        assert not errors,errors
        page.close()
    page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1440,'height':1000})
    old=render.audit(page,'http://127.0.0.1:4183/datafolha_08102026.html')
    report.append({'old_dossier_render':old})
    browser.close()
(root/'tmp/datafolha_221026/qa.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
PY

import json
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

contrast = importlib.import_module('contrast-audit')

        page.locator('#round-f').fill('47.49')
        page.locator('#round-l').fill('45.50')
        assert '51 × 49' in page.locator('#round-result').inner_text()
        page.locator('#round-f').fill('46.80')
        page.locator('#round-l').fill('46.49')
        page.locator('.rounding-lab').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/rounding-{width}.png'))
        page.locator('#cotas').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/quotas-{width}.png'))
        options=page.locator('#d-question option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for option in options:
            page.locator('#d-question').select_option(option)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
            href=page.locator('#d-explorer-chart a[href*="#page="]').first.get_attribute('href')
            assert 'datafolha_22102026.pdf#page=' in href,href
        page.locator('#d-question').select_option('voto')
        dimensions=page.locator('#d-dimension option').evaluate_all('(els)=>els.map(e=>e.value)')
        for value in dimensions:
            page.locator('#d-dimension').select_option(value)
            assert page.locator('#d-explorer-chart table tbody tr').count()>0
        page.locator('#explorador').screenshot(path=str(root/f'tmp/datafolha_221026/explorer-{width}.png'))

        assert not errors,errors
        page.close()
    page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1440,'height':1000})
    old=render.audit(page,'http://127.0.0.1:4183/datafolha_08102026.html')
    report.append({'old_dossier_render':old})
    browser.close()
